premises.text: Knowledge is often siloed within enterprises, leading to repeated work and mistakes.
premises.evidence_span: the root cause of this was simply because all the knowledge was siloed.

premises.text: A Q&A platform can facilitate knowledge sharing within enterprises.
premises.evidence_span: we take the power of a Q&A site, meld it with the flexibility of wikis to create a really organically growing, really easily searchable knowledge base for the enterprise.

premises.text: Integrating with email can enhance user engagement with the knowledge platform.
premises.evidence_span: we allow people to ask questions directly by email, answer them directly by replying to an email.

premises.text: Anonymity in questions can encourage more honest inquiries in the enterprise context.
premises.evidence_span: allows for people to ask questions that maybe they thought was a little bit stupid, but really are important.

premises.text: A powerful search engine is essential for users to find previous answers efficiently.
premises.evidence_span: we have a very fast, very powerful search engine that allows people to find previous answers to questions that they have already.

premises.text: The platform can be adapted for various use cases across different industries.
premises.evidence_span: you could use this like a mini internal stack overflow for documenting bugs and solutions.

value.text: Companies can share knowledge effectively through a collaborative platform.
value.evidence_span: Opsy's mission is to help people at companies share knowledge.
